purpose: Execute the atomic create-linear-pattern operation within the MA-18 boundary: One linear array effect for unlinked transient body instances. It copies the supplied body count times, preserves the source, applies known translation matrices to copies after index 0, and does not create native associative pattern features, attach bodies, or edit components/occurrences.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires create-linear-pattern and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: A closed nonempty transient source body; attached DesignBody and component/occurrence variants are excluded.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Finite nonzero linear-array direction; normalized by the shared direction helper.

inputs.name: spacing_mm
inputs.description: Positive distance between consecutive instance locations in millimetres.

inputs.name: count
inputs.description: Finite integer-valued instance count; the source location is included, but every returned instance is an independent copy.

inputs.name: volume_tolerance_mm3
inputs.description: Tolerance for comparing every copied instance volume with the source volume.

preconditions: count is a finite integer >= 2 and booleans are rejected.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: {instances: array<transient Modeler.Body>, offsets_mm: array<number[3]>, source_policy: "preserved", association: "independent"}; offsets include [0,0,0] for the copied source location.

postconditions: Exactly count independent transient instances are returned, including a copy at the source location.
The supplied source body is not transformed or consumed.
offsets_mm contains count cumulative offsets [index * spacing_mm * normalized direction] in millimetres.
Every returned instance passes require_transient/assert_closed and preserves source volume within volume_tolerance_mm3.
The returned source_policy is preserved and association is independent.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21 / IronPython 2.7 action wrapper; runtime execution is evidenced by the attached exact candidate host record; native persistence, visual review, and requested export remain outside this action.
implementation.notes: Execute the atomic create-linear-pattern operation within the MA-18 boundary: One linear array effect for unlinked transient body instances. It copies the supplied body count times, preserves the source, applies known translation matrices to copies after index 0, and does not create native associative pattern features, attach bodies, or edit components/occurrences. Untested variants remain outside the attached exact-run evidence.

recovery.action: Supply a fresh valid transient source and corrected finite parameters; no model mutation has occurred.
Discard all partial transient instances and rerun from the unchanged source; no rollback is implemented.
